# Example workspace map

A launchpad, not a project. This map lists the repositories this workspace
knows, one line per project, with the projects each one uses. Before working in
a repository, read that repository's own `AGENTS.md` (or its README), at that
point and not up front.

<!-- workspace:keep begin top -->
<!-- workspace:keep end top -->

## Repos by cluster

**Storefront** — The public shop and its API.
- `shop-web`: Storefront web application. lifecycle: active. uses: shop-api (runtime)
- `shop-api`: Storefront API. lifecycle: maintenance.
- `ingest`: see Data.

**Data** — Pipelines and reports.
- `ingest`: Nightly ingest pipeline. lifecycle: active.
- `reports`: Weekly reports. lifecycle: active.

**Retired systems** (lifecycle: archived): `old-cart`. Systems now owned elsewhere.

## Registering and declining

This map is generated from `registry.yaml`; everything outside the two keep
blocks is rewritten. To add a repository, run `workspace register WORKSPACE PATH
--cluster ID --one-liner TEXT`; to keep one off the map, run `workspace decline
WORKSPACE PATTERN --reason TEXT`. Each prints a plan and a plan hash; run it
again with `--write --expect HASH`, then run `workspace gen` the same way.
